requirements: Coding agent with a shell; Python 3, Playwright with Chromium, FFmpeg and numpy (the prompt installs what's missing).
No voice and no paid services: the sound is made in code.

artifacts.label: Creator’s post with the video and prompt

preview.description: A 29-second flat-vector "What if you could see everyone's ...?" episode: a glowing number above every head, counters that roll, a red X on every wrong guess and a twist, every frame drawn in code with a lo-fi beat made in numpy.

video.caption: Original episode by Singh; creator reports Claude Opus.
